assets.name: Claire Redfield
assets.edition: Resident Evil 2 Remake (2019), Claire Costume: Military DLC
assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one full-body character-selection key for Resident Evil Combat.
Edit image 1 into ONE new single pose; images 2 and 3 are supporting native game references, not extra subjects. Preserve the same exact adult identity, face, hairstyle, costume, anatomical equipment sides, body proportions and detailed semi-realistic painted 2D sprite style. Use the native references to keep clothing construction and asymmetry accurate. This is a reference-guided project adaptation; do not invent a different game incarnation.
Composition: portrait canvas, requested 1024 x 1536. The COMPLETE silhouette, including hair, hands and both boot soles, must occupy only about 72-75% of canvas height. Intentionally zoom out from image 1: leave at least 12% fully transparent blank margin on all four sides; place head near y=205 and lowest boot sole near y=1320 on a 1536-high canvas. Center near x=512. Maintain those same body scale and foot baseline across selection keys. Exactly one character, one pose, clear complete fingers and footwear.
Scene/backdrop: actual alpha transparency. No floor, cast shadow, pedestal, gradient, glow, colored aura, halo, scene, UI, lettering, frame, diagram, inset or sheet. Do not mirror the figure or move equipment to the opposite anatomical side. No duplicate or second view. Keep both hands empty as in image 1; the guns in the native references are not requested props.
Subject: adult Claire Redfield, Resident Evil 2 Remake (2019), official Claire Costume: Military DLC. Keep the camouflage bandana with tied ends, brown hair/loose strands, off-white tank under olive tactical vest, correct native vest pouches and patches, camouflage cargo trousers, and black lace-up combat boots. Preserve the tattoo on the anatomical RIGHT upper arm, black thigh holster with two straps on anatomical RIGHT leg, watch on anatomical LEFT wrist and canteen at anatomical LEFT rear hip. Keep original shapes/colors of the two lower vest badges and flag; no new logos, no reinterpretation as a BSAA uniform. Do not add red jacket, gloves, shotgun or launcher.
Pose change only: SELECTED / attentive preview. Torso nearly frontal with a small natural three-quarter turn toward viewer-right. Head upright and attentive toward viewer-right. Feet planted shoulder-width apart. Lower both hands from the high fists of image 1 into a relaxed low ready position beside the lower vest, elbows slightly bent, fingers naturally relaxed. Calm focused expression; no attack, no salute, no theatrical gesture. This is one still key, not an animation sheet.
